description: This Java class manages a MIDI output port selector in an Android application, allowing users to choose a MIDI output port and send MIDI messages through it.

classes.name: MidiOutputPortSelector
classes.description: A class that extends MidiPortSelector to manage the selection and handling of MIDI output ports, including opening, closing, and connecting MIDI output ports, and providing a MidiSender for message transmission.

methods.name: MidiOutputPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the selector with the MIDI manager, activity, and spinner ID particular to output ports.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles the event when a MIDI port is selected; opens the device and port, and connects a dispatcher to it.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Cleans up by disconnecting and closing open MIDI ports and devices.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns a MidiSender that sends messages through the currently selected and connected MIDI output port.
